Thanks for the heads up, Samantha — totally understood. Two practical paths we recommend (we can execute either quickly):

Option A — Split:
- Keep a short onsite executive + product demo when leadership is available (proposed: Tue Oct 27, 09:30–13:00).
- Move the technical deep-dive to a remote session (90–120m) the following week (suggested: Thu Oct 29 or Mon Nov 2). Connor will run the deep-dive and can record it.
- Deliverables: exec recording + slides, recorded technical session, targeted follow-up items.

Option B — Compress onsite + local cover:
- Compress the onsite to a single day (Mon Oct 26) with a 90m exec overview and 2h hands-on.
- Marissa can lead the afternoon hands-on remotely or be onsite if you prefer. Connor can run the technical deep-dive remotely the next day and record.

Notes:
- If you pick Option A, we’ll update the agenda (I’ve attached Mulligan_Demo_Agenda_v3.pdf) and confirm room/time.
- If Option B, Marissa confirmed she can change travel to be in the area and cover on-site morning if needed.

Please let us know which option you prefer and whether Tom needs the deck by end of day.

— Diego
